url.description: url of the HC vault instance

jwtTtl.description: Time in seconds for the GitHub OIDC JWT token lifetime (e.g., "10800" for 3 hours). Defaults to 3600 (1 hour) if not specified.

role.description:
Vault JWT role to use for authentication. If not provided, auto-selects based on GITHUB_REF:
- Protected refs (main, master, branch-*, tags/*) use 'github-{org}
